svg:svg.svg:text: Different attention heads specialize in distinct linguistic patterns, enabling nuanced understanding.
Two attention heads in layer 5 resolving anaphora. Head 5 focuses on 'Law', head 6 on 'application'.
Source: Attention is All You Need (Vaswani et al., 2017)
学而时习之 不亦说乎
